lines.en: label sanadorm40:
scene sanawalkedhome1
: Um...thanks again for...walking all the way here with me, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……又谢谢你……一路陪我走到这里，Sensei……

lines.en: : I feel a little bad that...you didn’t even get to have a drink first...
lines.zh: : 你……连杯酒都没喝上，我有点过意不去……

lines.en: : You can just make it up to me by giving me free beer for the next month. That seems fair to me.
lines.zh: : 那你下个月给我免费供酒就行。我觉得这挺公平的。

lines.en: : The price for...hanging out with you is pretty high...huh?
lines.zh: : 跟你待在一起的代价……还挺高的……呢？

lines.en: : Supply and demand, Sana. Supply and demand.
lines.zh: : 供需关系而已，Sana。供需关系。

lines.en: I’m surprised the two of us made it all the way up here without her giving the signal that it was time for me to leave.
lines.zh: 我们两个一路走到这儿，她居然都没给过我该走人的信号，我挺意外的。

lines.en: Here I was, ready to tuck my hands into my pockets and rush over to the closest convenience store for a hot beverage, but-
lines.zh: 我本来都准备好把手插进口袋、冲去最近的便利店买杯热饮了，可是——

lines.en: Somehow or another, I’m outside of Sana’s dorm.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我已经站在 Sana 的宿舍外面了。

lines.en: : Well there...sure is a lot of demand for you, so...I guess I understand...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你确实……需求量很大，所以……我大概明白……

lines.en: : Can I...umm...ask you something, though?
lines.zh: : 不过我……嗯……能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : Is it another pricing question? Because I might need to have you call my secretary if it is.
lines.zh: : 又是关于价钱的问题吗？如果是的话，我可能得让你给我的秘书打电话了。

lines.en: : It’s not a...pricing question...
lines.zh: : 不是……价钱的问题……

lines.en: : I just wanted to ask if you could...keep all of that stuff about my mom a secret...
lines.zh: : 我只是想问，你能不能……把关于我妈妈的事都保密……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome2
: Of course. It’s not like I’d come out and just tell someone, “Hey. Sana’s mom is in denial about the death of her son. Pass it on.”
lines.zh: : 当然。我又不会跑出去跟别人说：“嘿。Sana 她妈妈还无法接受她儿子已经死了。帮我传一下。”

lines.en: : I’m more worried about you...saying something about it to her...
lines.zh: : 我更担心的是你……当着她的面说漏嘴……

lines.en: : And then what? Watch her break down in front of me and not know how to handle it?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？看着她在我面前崩溃，我却不知道该怎么办？

lines.en: : I’m by no means a good person, but it’s not like I’m {i}evil{/i}, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我算不上什么好人，但也不至于那么{i}坏{/i}，Sana。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome3
: Then it...shouldn’t be an issue for you to promise me, right?
lines.zh: : 那……你答应我这件事，应该不难吧？

lines.en: : I’ve compared you to a...dad a few times tonight, but...you aren’t family...
lines.zh: : 今晚我好几次把你比作……爸爸，可是……你又不是家人……

lines.en: : So you shouldn’t really get involved...
lines.zh: : 所以你其实不该插手……

lines.en: : Are you saying you want to live in denial as well, then?
lines.zh: : 那你是说，你也想继续自欺欺人下去？

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome4
: I’m not denying anything...
lines.zh: : 我没有否认任何事……

lines.en: : My big brother died and...part of me died with him.
lines.zh: : 我哥哥死了，而……我的一部分也跟着他死了。

lines.en: : But the part that’s left needs to stay intact so...my mom can stay sane.
lines.zh: : 可剩下的那部分必须保持完整，这样……我妈妈才能保持清醒。

lines.en: : Crazy to think that just the other day, your big breakthrough moment was confessing that you suddenly wanted to learn karate.
lines.zh: 想想真疯狂，就在几天前，你最大的突破还是坦白说你突然想学空手道。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome5
: H-Hey! Th-that was...probably even harder to come out and say than...all of this...
lines.zh: : 喂！那……那件事说出口，说不定比……这些还难……

lines.en: : It would be weird if...everyone I know kept getting closer to you and I stayed...
lines.zh: : 如果我认识的每个人都跟你越来越亲近，而我却一直停在原地……那也太奇怪了……

lines.en: : On the inside of a triangle?
lines.zh: : 待在三角形的内部？

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome6
: That’s...actually a really good way of wording it...
lines.zh: : 这……其实是个非常贴切的说法……

lines.en: : Thanks. I thought it up on the way over.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我来的路上想出来的。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome7
: Hah...all I kept thinking of was...how weird it felt walking around with you and...how tall you are...
lines.zh: : 哈……我脑子里一直想的都是……跟你一起走路感觉有多奇怪，还有……你有多高……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome1
: B-But...yes...
: I’m on the...inside of a triangle...
lines.zh: : 我就在……三角形的内部……

lines.en: : And I...told myself that I’ll start being more honest with you...
lines.zh: : 而我……告诉自己，我要开始对你更诚实一些……

lines.en: : And what better place to do that than karate lessons?
lines.zh: : 还有什么地方比空手道课更适合这么做呢？

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome8
: Stop bringing up karate lessons!
lines.zh: : 别再提空手道课了！

lines.en: : And...and stop bringing up spaghetti!
lines.zh: : 还有……还有别再提意大利面！

lines.en: : I didn’t even mention spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 我根本没提意大利面。

lines.en: : You were going to! You have the...spaghetti look in your eyes!
lines.zh: : 你正要提！你眼睛里就是一副……意大利面的表情！

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome9
: Pfft...
: What am I...even saying right now?
lines.zh: : 我到底……在说些什么啊？

lines.en: It’s peculiar what jealousy can do to a person.
lines.zh: 嫉妒能把一个人变成什么样，真是奇妙。

lines.en: Between the Christmas party and now...and even before that, Sana and I never really had a dramatic shift in our dynamic.
lines.zh: 从圣诞派对到现在……甚至在那之前，我和 Sana 的关系从来都没有过什么戏剧性的转折。

lines.en: She’s always just...been there being cute and...doing cute things, but-
lines.zh: 她一直都……在那里，可爱地……做着可爱的事，可是——

lines.en: We’re actually getting somewhere now.
lines.zh: 现在我们是真的有所进展了。

lines.en: Maybe I {i}don’t{/i} just want to protect her? (And obviously have sex with her because...come on. I'm only human.)
lines.zh: 也许我{i}不只是{/i}想保护她？（当然还想跟她上床，因为……拜托，我只是个凡人。）

lines.en: But maybe I want to learn about her?
lines.zh: 但也许我是想了解她？

lines.en: Maybe I want to watch her...try and fail?
lines.zh: 也许我想看着她……尝试，然后失败？

lines.en: To learn from her mistakes-
lines.zh: 从她的错误中学习——

lines.en: Maybe even succeed sometimes-
lines.zh: 也许偶尔还会成功——

lines.en: And to keep nervously smiling at me like I expect her to any moment now.
lines.zh: 还有继续那样紧张地冲我笑，就像我随时都在等她笑一样。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome10
: Are you...um...
: Are you...cold?
lines.zh: : 你……冷吗？

lines.en: Right on cue.
lines.zh: 说曹操曹操到。

lines.en: : Of course. It’s freezing out.
lines.zh: : 当然冷。外面冻死了。

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 你为什么问这个？

lines.en: : Well, you...walked the whole way here, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你……一路走过来的，所以……

lines.en: : If you want to...come warm up inside my room for a little while...
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意……进我房间暖和一会儿的话……

lines.en: : That’s...that’s okay...
lines.zh: : 那样……那样也行……

lines.en: Holy crap, am I actually being invited in?
lines.zh: 我去，我是真的被邀请进去了？

lines.en: It’s way later than I’m usually here.
lines.zh: 这比我平时来的时间晚多了。

lines.en: Is she really okay with this?
lines.zh: 她真的没关系吗？

lines.en: What has happened to my precious, reserved little Sana?
lines.zh: 我那个宝贝的、内向的小 Sana 到底怎么了？

lines.en: : You do realize how this sounds, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这话听起来像什么吧？

lines.en: : I...have no idea what you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你在说什么……

lines.en: : But, um...Ayane isn’t home tonight and...it’s easier to talk about stuff when we’re...in a private room...
lines.zh: : 不过，嗯……Ayane 今晚不在，而且……在私密的房间里……比较容易谈事情……

lines.en: : Do you {i}really{/i} not realize how this sounds?
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}不知道这话听起来像什么吗？

lines.en: : I told you...I...I have no idea what you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我说了……我……我不知道你在说什么……

lines.en: : I just...don’t really want you to go home yet...or something...
lines.zh: : 我只是……还不太想让你回家……之类的……

lines.en: : When you say it like that, how could I possibly refuse?
lines.zh: : 你都这么说了，我怎么可能拒绝？

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome11
: R...Really?
lines.zh: : 真……真的吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I always knew you were going to say yes because...you’re a very...sketchy person...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我早就知道你会答应了，因为……你是个很……可疑的人……

lines.en: : But it’s...still nice...actually hearing it.
lines.zh: : 不过……亲耳听到……还是很高兴。

lines.en: : Okay, you’re still new to this, so I won’t be too harsh. But you don’t normally insult someone immediately after inviting them inside.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你对这种事还不熟练，我就不太计较了。不过一般人刚把人请进屋，可不会马上 insult 对方。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome9
: Heheh...it wasn’t meant as an insult...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我没有 insult 你的意思……

lines.en: : I...like how unpredictable you are...
lines.zh: : 我……喜欢你捉摸不透的样子……

lines.en: : It makes me...do things outside of my comfort zone...
lines.zh: : 它让我……做出舒适区之外的事……

lines.en: : It’s...nice having someone like that again...
lines.zh: : 身边又有了这样的人……真好……

lines.en: scene black
Sana opens the door and steps aside, lightly bowing to me and allowing me to walk in first.
lines.zh: Sana 打开门让到一边，轻轻鞠了一躬，让我先进去。

lines.en: Technically, I’m probably the one who should be doing that for her-
lines.zh: 严格来说，应该是我对她做这种事才对——

lines.en: But since she offered, I’m obviously going to walk in.
lines.zh: 不过既然她让了，我当然就进去了。

lines.en: Otherwise we’d just have two people standing around in the hallway and looking even more suspicious than we already were with our one-foot height gap.
lines.zh: 否则我们两个就只能站在走廊里大眼瞪小眼，而且我们身高差了一英尺，本来就够可疑了，那样只会更可疑。

lines.en: : Oh, Sana! You’re home!
lines.zh: : 哦，Sana！你回来了！

lines.en: : I texted you and you didn’t respond, but I decided to-
lines.zh: : 我给你发消息你没回，我就决定——

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome12
: Stay home tonight...
lines.zh: : 今晚待在家里……

lines.en: : O-Oh! I’m...sorry...
: My...umm...my phone died on the way home...
lines.zh: : 我的……嗯……我的手机在回来的路上没电了……

lines.en: : What are you doing here so late?
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么晚在这儿？

lines.en: : And why are you two together?
lines.zh: : 还有你们两个怎么在一起？

lines.en: : I walked Sana home from work.
lines.zh: : 我送 Sana 下班回家。

lines.en: : You walked...all the way from the bar with her?
lines.zh: : 你从酒吧一路……陪她走回来的？

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : You didn't just run into her on your way somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 你不是去别的地方的路上偶然碰到她的？

lines.en: : I...did not.
lines.zh: : 我……不是。

lines.en: Sana nervously closes the door and takes a step toward Ayane with great hesitation.
lines.zh: Sana 紧张地关上门，十分犹豫地朝 Ayane 迈了一步。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome13
: Um...Ayane...it was me who...asked him to t-take me home...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Ayane……是我……请他送我回家的……

lines.en: : And you invited him into the room as well?
lines.zh: : 你还把他请进房间了？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...
: Even though it’s getting close to midnight and you knew I wasn’t going to be home?
lines.zh: : 尽管已经快到午夜了，而且你知道我不在家？

lines.en: : Well...it was cold out...so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……外面很冷……所以……

lines.en: : I thought he could...warm up...
lines.zh: : 我想他可以……暖和一下……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome14
: Do you need to warm up, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你需要暖和一下吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You’ve been in my bed several times before, so you know how warm it can get when you hide under the covers.
lines.zh: : 你之前在我床上待过好几次了，所以你知道躲在被子里会有多暖和。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: else:
: No. Stay away from me. If you touch me, I will scream.
lines.zh: : 不。离我远点。你要是碰我，我就尖叫。

lines.en: Okay, well, everyone here is clearly uncomfortable now.
lines.zh: 好吧，现在显然在场的所有人都很不自在了。

lines.en: Obviously, Ayane would be a bit confused seeing me walk into the room with Sana at this hour, especially since she was supposed to be away tonight.
lines.zh: Ayane 看到我在这个点和 Sana 一起走进房间，自然会有点困惑，尤其她今晚本该不在的。

lines.en: Any rational person would come to the same conclusion.
lines.zh: 任何一个理性的人都会得出同样的结论。

lines.en: And hell, Ayane isn’t even always rational and she’s seemed to reach that exact end-point.
lines.zh: 而且，Ayane 甚至算不上一直理性，可她似乎也走到了完全相同的结论。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome15
: How was work?
lines.zh: : 工作怎么样？

lines.en: : Did you have a good time?
lines.zh: : 玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Seems like you closed early.
lines.zh: : 看起来你们提前打烊了。

lines.en: : Um...y...yeah...we did...
: Otherwise, Sensei wouldn’t have...
lines.zh: : 不然 Sensei 也不会……

lines.en: : Wouldn’t have what?
lines.zh: : 也不会什么？

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome16
: She probably wants to say I wouldn’t have bothered walking home with her if it was any later.
lines.zh: : 她大概是想说，要是再晚一点，我就不会愿意陪她走回家了。

lines.en: : Is that true, though?
lines.zh: : 不过这是真的吗？

lines.en: : No. I still would have walked with her.
lines.zh: : 不是。我还是会陪她走的。

lines.en: : Of course you would.
lines.zh: : 你当然会。

lines.en: : Because you’re kind and caring and compassionate and lovely and wonderful.
lines.zh: : 因为你善良、体贴、有同情心、又可爱又美好。

lines.en: : And so is Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana 也一样。

lines.en: : I...I know what it looks like...but that’s really...not what’s happening...
lines.zh: : 我……我知道这看起来像什么……可事情真的……不是那样……

lines.en: : I’ll probably believe that in the morning but, right now, I’m just trying to get some thoughts sorted out.
lines.zh: : 也许到了早上我就会相信了，不过现在，我只是想理清一些念头。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome17
: It’s...definitely a little bit of a shock, though...hahahaha...
lines.zh: : 不过……确实挺让人震惊的……哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: : I can’t even remember what I was about to say before you walked in.
lines.zh: : 我甚至想不起来你进来之前我正要说什么了。

lines.en: : I’m not normally this forgetful.
lines.zh: : 我平时没这么健忘的。

lines.en: : Sensei, pinch me and turn me back to normal.
lines.zh: : Sensei，掐我一下，把我变回正常吧。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome18
: A-Ayane!
lines.zh: : A……Ayane！

lines.en: : Hm? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Can we maybe...talk out in the hallway for a minute?...
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……去走廊谈一会儿？……

lines.en: : The hallway? Why not just talk in here?
lines.zh: : 走廊？为什么不能在这儿谈？

lines.en: : Because it’s...something...I want to tell you and not...S...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 因为这是……我想告诉你的事，而不想让……S……Sensei 听到……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome19
: But...what if it’s something I don’t want to hear?
lines.zh: : 可是……万一那是我不想听的事呢？

lines.en: : It’s something...I {i}want{/i} you to hear...
lines.zh: : 那是……我{i}想{/i}让你听的事……

lines.en: : And...that should be enough...right?
lines.zh: : 而……这就够了……对吧？

lines.en: : I...listen to things you tell me all the time and...I don’t ever...say anything bad about them...
lines.zh: : 你跟我说的事我……从来都认真听，而且……我从来没……说过什么不好的话……

lines.en: : Yeah...I know...I just-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道……我只是——

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome20
: Sensei...I’m sorry but...maybe it’s best if you...go home now...
lines.zh: : Sensei……对不起，不过……也许你……现在该回家了……

lines.en: : Yeah. I was just thinking about how warm I’ve suddenly become anyway.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我刚刚还在想，我怎么突然就变热了。

lines.en: : R...Right...
: And...um...I’m sorry that...you weren’t able to stay longer...
lines.zh: : 还有……嗯……抱歉你……没能多待一会儿……

lines.en: : I’m sure your legs are-
lines.zh: : 我想你的腿一定——

lines.en: : My legs are fine. You’re underestimating just how much I walk around this god forsaken town.
lines.zh: : 我的腿没事。你太小看我在这座被神遗弃的小镇上走了多少路了。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome21
: Goodnight, you two. Sorry for showing up unannounced, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 晚安，你们两个。抱歉不打招呼就来了，Ayane。

lines.en: : What? Why are you apologizing to me? There’s no need to-
lines.zh: : 什么？你干嘛跟我道歉？没必要——

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei...I’m...I’m sorry again...
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei……我……我又得说对不起了……

lines.en: scene black
I exit the room and quickly make my way out of the dorm.
lines.zh: 我走出房间，迅速离开了宿舍。

lines.en: It feels a lot colder than it did thirty minutes ago, but I guess things like that happen once your body temperature readjusts to the way things are indoors.
lines.zh: 这比三十分钟前冷多了，不过我想，一旦体温重新适应了室内的状态，这种事就会发生。

lines.en: As I pass under streetlights, looking up at a suddenly cloudy sky, I think to myself about shapes.
lines.zh: 我从路灯下走过，抬头看向突然阴沉下来的天空，脑子里想着各种形状。

lines.en: About triangles, in particular.
lines.zh: 尤其是三角形。

lines.en: And about how difficult it would be to escape if you were to ever find yourself trapped inside of one.
lines.zh: 还有就是，一旦被困在三角形里面，要逃出来会有多难。

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome22
: Do you...want anything to drink?
lines.zh: : 你……想喝点什么吗？

lines.en: : Why do we have to do this in the hallway?
lines.zh: : 我们为什么非得在走廊里谈？

lines.en: : When my mom is feeling upset...I always offer to go for a walk with her...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈难过的时候……我总会提出陪她去散步……

lines.en: : And you’re feeling upset, so...I’m just...doing the only thing I know how to do...
lines.zh: : 而你现在很难过，所以……我只是……在做我唯一会做的事……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome23
: You know that I’m...not good with people...so I’m sorry if this doesn’t...work with you...
lines.zh: : 你知道我……不擅长跟人相处……所以如果这对你没用，我很抱歉……

lines.en: : I’m not just “people” though, Sana. I’m Ayane.
lines.zh: : 可我不只是“别人”啊，Sana。我是 Ayane。

lines.en: : We live in the same room and even sleep in the same bed sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我们住同一个房间，有时候甚至睡同一张床。

lines.en: : You know everything about me, so...
lines.zh: : 你知道关于我的一切，所以……
: 所以……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome24
: Why didn’t I know {i}this{/i} about you?...
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}这件{/i}事我却不知道？……

lines.en: : Wh...what? I don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 什……什么？我不明白……

lines.en: : When did you...start feeling this way about Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是什么时候……开始对 Sensei 有这种感觉的？

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome25
: Wha-
: What way?!
lines.zh: : 什么感觉？！

lines.en: : All...all we did was walk home together!
lines.zh: : 我们……我们只是走回家而已！

lines.en: : That may be all you did but...was that all you wanted?
lines.zh: : 也许你只做了这些，可是……你想要的就只有这些吗？

lines.en: : I just...want to know how long you’ve felt like this for...
lines.zh: : 我只是……想知道你有这种感觉多久了……

lines.en: : But...I don’t feel like anything!
lines.zh: : 可……我什么感觉都没有！

lines.en: : I’m...I’m out here talking to you because I wanted to clear up any misunderstandings you had!
lines.zh: : 我……我在这里跟你说话，是因为我想澄清你的误会！

lines.en: : What would you have done if Sensei tried to kiss you tonight?
lines.zh: : 如果今晚 Sensei 想吻你，你会怎么做？

lines.en: : Run away and die!
lines.zh: : 转身逃跑然后死掉！

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome26
: Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : Your brain and your heart are disconnected...
lines.zh: : 你的大脑和你的心是断开的……

lines.en: : No! That’s not what’s happening!
lines.zh: : 不！才不是那样！

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 就是那样。

lines.en: : It’s the same thing that happened to me.
lines.zh: : 我也经历过一模一样的事。

lines.en: : I just wish I would have found this out a lot less...suddenly.
lines.zh: : 我只希望我不是这么……突然地发现这件事。

lines.en: : You’re...you’re wrong!
lines.zh: : 你……你错了！

lines.en: : I don’t even understand what you’re saying but I...I know it’s wrong!
lines.zh: : 我甚至听不懂你在说什么，可我……我知道你是错的！

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome27
: Is everything okay out here?
lines.zh: : 外面一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : It’s not every day that you hear Sana yell like that.
lines.zh: : 平常可听不到 Sana 这么喊。

lines.en: : What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了？

lines.en: : It’s nothing, Maya...
lines.zh: : 没什么，Maya……

lines.en: : Sure as hell doesn’t sound like nothing.
lines.zh: : 听起来可绝对不像没什么。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, it’s clear that this is something I shouldn’t be involved with, so I’m gonna go back to bed.
lines.zh: : 好吧。看来这事明显不该我掺和，我还是回去睡觉了。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Maya.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Maya。

lines.en: : Good...Goodnight...
: Yeah.
: Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome28
: Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : I’ll...stop pestering you about it, but...
lines.zh: : 我……不再追问你了，不过……

lines.en: : I understand that it’s not possible to control how you feel about someone...
lines.zh: : 我明白，你对一个人的感觉是控制不了的……

lines.en: : I don’t feel that way about Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我对 Sensei 没有那种感觉……

lines.en: : I...can’t feel that way about him...
lines.zh: : 我……不能对他有那种感觉……

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re afraid of hurting me?
lines.zh: : 因为你怕伤害我？

lines.en: : My mom likes him too, you know...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈也喜欢他，你知道的……

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome29
: Oh, stop. We both know Sensei isn’t into girls your mom’s age.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你我都清楚，Sensei 对你妈妈那个年纪的女人没兴趣。
: 我们……

lines.en: : We do?...
lines.zh: : 我们清楚吗？……

lines.en: : That’s what I’m banking on, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少我是把赌注押在这上面的。

lines.en: : But if you {i}do{/i} feel that way about him-
lines.zh: : 可要是你{i}真的{/i}对他有那种感觉——

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我没有。

lines.en: : Right. But if you {i}do{/i}-
lines.zh: : 好。但如果你{i}有{/i}——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about something like hurting me.
lines.zh: : 别去担心会不会伤害我这种事。

lines.en: : I’ve been hurt plenty of times.
lines.zh: : 我受伤的次数够多了。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome30
: Also, I’ve made it my life’s mission to never give up on him.
lines.zh: : 还有，我把永不放弃他当成了自己的人生使命。

lines.en: : So even if you somehow manage to defeat me, I’ll take him back by any means necessary.
lines.zh: : 所以就算你 somehow 有办法赢过我，我也会不择手段把他抢回来。

lines.en: : Unless you’re willing to share.
lines.zh: : 除非你愿意分享。

lines.en: : Cause you know how cute I think you are and I probably wouldn't mind as long as it was a three-
lines.zh: : 因为你知道我觉得你有多可爱，而且只要是个三——我应该不会介意。

lines.en: scene sanawalkedhome31
: AYANE! STOP!!!!
lines.zh: : AYANE！别说了！！！！
